title: Incorporators.
bodyText:
PART III. INCORPORATION

One or more individuals may act as the incorporator or incorporators of a corporation by delivering articles of incorporation to the department director for filing.
bodyHtml:
PART III.  INCORPORATION

 

     [§414-31]  Incorporators.  One or more individuals may act as the incorporator or incorporators of a corporation by delivering articles of incorporation to the department director for filing. [L 2000, c 244, pt of §1]
